text: RB API-101 [RateLimit / HTTP429]: Downstream partner API burst triggering HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. Enable token-bucket rate limiter with jittered retry-after backoff and request coalescing.

RB API-102 [Resilience / CircuitBreaker]: Resilience4j circuit breaker transitioned to OPEN on inventory-service (failure rate > 50%). Route to cached fallback catalog response and inspect upstream DB pool.

RB API-103 [Contract / Jackson]: Spring Boot Jackson MismatchedInputException after upstream v3 schema added unknown enum field. Enable FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false and deploy tolerant reader patch.
RB API-104 [gRPC / Deadline]: gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED across multi-hop microservice call chain. Propagate context deadline headers and tune HTTP/2 max concurrent streams.
RB API-105 [mTLS / Istio]: Istio ingress gateway mTLS handshake failure due to expired SPIFFE workload certificate. Restart istiod / cert-manager agent to force SDS secret rotation.
RB API-106 [Security / JWTLeak]: API gateway access log captured unredacted Bearer token and prompt injection string. Strip Authorization headers in Envoy access log format and revoke token.
RB API-107 [CORS / Preflight]: Browser SPA failing with CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin mismatch on OPTIONS preflight. Add production origin domain to gateway CORS policy.
RB API-108 [GraphQL / Depth]: Deeply nested GraphQL query caused N+1 resolver CPU spike. Enforce max query depth = 7 and enable DataLoader batching.
RB API-109 [TLS / Cipher]: Legacy B2B client failing TLS 1.3 handshake on strict cipher suite. Enable TLS 1.2 ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 compatibility profile on dedicated partner listener.
RB API-110 [Caching / ETag]: CDN / API Gateway cache-hit ratio dropped to 8% due to Vary: Cookie header leak. Strip unnecessary session cookies on public GET /catalog routes.
